defect_families.evidence: The 24-hour freshness cutoff is sampled from the runtime UTC clock in global_coverage; market observation times come from provider payload fields and are parsed defensively. Capacity cooldown and rolling-window times are runtime-generated in capacity.py, and a bounded Retry-After is clamped before sleeping. No caller-supplied timestamp can move an admission, ordering, budget or coverage cutoff. Focused regressions include stale-market-evidence rejection and bounded Retry-After.

try_reserve_capacity and set_capacity_cooldown use BEGIN IMMEDIATE so dedup lookup, rolling-window count and insert observe one SQLite snapshot; completion is keyed by a unique reservation id. Backfill dedup suppression is passed explicitly at request construction rather than inferred across two reads. capacity.py and repository.py regressions cover retry dedup and cooldown persistence.

Dex batch rows retain the registry chain for provider id, slug, contract namespace and identity merging; the full DexScreener chainId is used only for the URL and response filtering. normalize_contract_address is applied to exact provider addresses before grouping, and no caller-selected identity can override a repository-assigned candidate id. Mode tests pin contract selection by existing identity.

Unknown or unconfigured providers fall back to an explicitly disabled provider config; absent capacity inventory entries have not_documented provenance and null numeric limits rather than permissive defaults. Budget exhaustion raises CapacityBudgetExhausted, which is now recorded as an unavailable run. No missing endpoint row is treated as unlimited permission.

Capacity observations are written only to additive dedicated tables with explicit provider/endpoint/fingerprint/reservation fields; no credential, token or excluded payload is nested into candidate metadata. Coverage telemetry is derived from persisted registry state, not from hidden metadata channels. No persistence restriction was weakened.

Rolling-window budgets are derived from persisted attempted_at rows with deterministic wait calculation; reservations use unique ids and retries reuse the original dedup key, so restart or repeat does not double-count a successful call. Batch truncation is reported from per-request accounting rather than retrying indefinitely. Focused tests cover retry dedup, truncation and fair rotation.
